title: NMDC Marks 69th Foundation Day, CMD Amitava Mukherjee Highlights Record Production and Vision 2030
dek: Indian Masterminds reports that NMDC marked its 69th Foundation Day, at which CMD Amitava Mukherjee highlighted record production and the company's Vision 2030.
summary: Indian Masterminds reports that NMDC marked its 69th Foundation Day, at which CMD Amitava Mukherjee highlighted record production and the company's Vision 2030. The publisher's excerpt does not give production figures or the specific targets under Vision 2030.
keyFacts: CMD Amitava Mukherjee highlighted record production
whyItMatters: As India's largest iron ore miner, NMDC's output trajectory influences domestic ore availability for steelmakers.
implications: Steel producers dependent on merchant ore may watch for the detail of NMDC's Vision 2030 targets, which the material does not supply.

related.title: NMDC Targets 24 MTPA Pellet Production Capacity as It Plans to Scale Up Iron Ore Output to 100 MT
related.dek: NMDC is targeting 24 MTPA of pellet capacity as it plans to scale iron ore output to 100 MT, according to Indian Masterminds.

related.title: Landslide damages NMDC mining waste dump, village road in Dantewada; no one hurt
